notes: Staines got a body lock early and returned Abushaar to the mat twice; the second slam drove him onto his head and shoulder and knocked him out.
First slam knockout in Contender Series history. Contract awarded.

rounds.summary: Staines closed distance, secured a body-lock takedown and brought Abushaar back down each time he tried to rise. The second mat return landed Abushaar on his head and shoulder, knocking him out; follow-up strikes ended it at 1:01.

recap.note: One-minute fight; MMA News, Yahoo and BJJ TV agree on the sequence. No Sherdog play-by-play found for DWCS week 8.

notes: Sabanov cracked Diop with a hook in R1, but Diop answered with a takedown at the fence and ground strikes.
Diop's pressure and clinch work broke Sabanov in R2 for a standing TKO at 2:13. Contract awarded.

rounds.summary: Exchanges on the inside after a caught kick; Sabanov landed a hook that cracked Diop. Diop then took Sabanov down at the fence and landed shots before Sabanov got up, and the round ended in exchanges.
Diop landed a combination just over a minute in and kept Sabanov pinned under pressure, landing in the clinch and at close range until the referee stopped it standing at 2:13.

recap.note: R1 edge to Diop per MMA News/Yahoo (takedown, 'wore down Sabanov through Round 1'); no staff round score published.

notes: Escuza landed early, threw Borando and finished with knees from back control/clinch at 0:32.
The final knee was ruled legal despite Borando being grounded. Contract awarded.

rounds.summary: Escuza landed solid strikes, threw Borando and took his back, landing knees to the body and head. The stoppage came at 0:32; the last knee was ruled legal though Borando was grounded.

notes: Bertolso took Reynoso down early, controlled from top and locked an inverted D'Arce with a body triangle for the tap at 3:02.

rounds.summary: Bertolso scored a quick takedown and controlled from a stack position, transitioned through a D'Arce grip, locked a body triangle and forced the tap at 3:02.

lessons: Final picks (last revision before lock): winners 3/4, rounds 3/4, method 3/4. Opening picks: winners 3/4, rounds 0/4, method 2/4. The Bulaid-Visconde bout was pulled on fight day (Bulaid illness) and moved to week 10, so it is ungraded here.

All four fights ended inside 2:15 of R2 (three in R1). The opening picks had Over on all four; the pre-lock revisions switched three to Under and all three hit. The one we left on Over (Bertolso, a 7-0 fighter with 5 finishes in 7) ended by R1 submission.

Only winner miss: Sabanov (53% final, 58% opening) over Diop. The call rested on Sabanov's 4-0 short record, a 3-inch height edge and Diop having one loss. Diop answered an R1 hook with a takedown, then broke Sabanov with pressure and clinch work in R2. A 4-fight record against an unknown level is thin evidence for a heavyweight pick.

Staines was right for the right reasons (unbeaten, better opposition), and the revised KO/TKO + Under matched a 61-second slam KO. Escuza's revised call (50%, Under, KO/TKO) hit on all three, but at 50% it was a coin flip on the winner.

Initial review. Round-by-round is from MMA News, Yahoo Sports and BJJ TV (no Sherdog play-by-play found for this card). Re-check through Oct 2. Closing odds added Oct 1 from DraftKings Network's fight-day lines (2:30 p.m. ET, the last pre-fight line found); the market had Sabanov -345, so the Diop miss was shared with the market.
Oct 1 follow-up: Sherdog, Cageside Press and MMA Mania re-searched; still no Sherdog play-by-play for this card and Cageside lists results only. Recaps stay complete from MMA News / Yahoo / BJJ TV.

bouts.note: Picked Sabanov on a 4-0 record, height and 'cleaner losses'. Diop's wrestling and pressure decided it: a takedown after being cracked in R1, then a standing TKO at 2:13 of R2. The engine has no read on a heavyweight's takedown game, and Sabanov's sample was 4 fights. The Under (revised) hit.

Winner right, but the rounds (Over) and method (Decision) missed on an R1 inverted D'Arce at 3:02. Bertolso had finished 5 of her last 7; the method call again ignored the favourite's own finishing rate (same lesson as OKTAGON 94's Dulatov and Cordero).

modelChanges: Proposal (for Suleman): on DWCS cards, when the picked side has finished at least 5 of their last 7 wins, lean Under 1.5 and a finish, unless the opponent has never been stopped. DWCS weeks 7-8 have mostly ended by R2. Backtest over DWCS weeks 1-8 before adopting.
Proposal (repeat): the method call should weight the picked winner's own finishing mix, not only the opponent's loss history.

noNote.reason: Slammed unconscious 61 seconds in; one takedown sequence says little new about his game.
Stopped by knees after 32 seconds; too short to learn anything reliable.
